CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid template for telegram-amazon-orders-returns, a personal Telegram bot that polls your own Amazon account (via the unofficial amazon-orders library, since Amazon has no buyer-facing API) for order, delivery, return, and transaction activity, and pushes updates to Telegram, including return drop-off QR codes. Optionally publishes counts to Home Assistant via MQTT. Support goes through this repository's GitHub issues.
